result.topic_en: Riemann maps the region between two non-concentric circles to an annulus with the Möbius map $\zeta=(z-k_1)/(z-k_2)$, and expands the complex potential of two charges $m_1, m_2$ in Laurent series and infinite products. Boundary conditions on the circles $\rho=\rho_1$ and $\rho=\rho_2$ fix the Laurent coefficients.

methods.what: Möbius map sending two circles to concentric circles
Complex potential written as the log of a ratio of infinite products (theta-type products)
Laurent series in the annulus written in polar form
Linear system fixing the Laurent coefficients from boundary data on the two circles
Laplace equation in logarithmic polar coordinates
Periodicity condition on the function χ
